summary: Shows task result tests failed, changed, succeeded/success and skipped on a registered result; from 2.1 alternative forms like failure, change and skip also work.
questions: How do I check whether a registered task failed or changed?
What task status tests are available?

answer_card.title: Testing task results
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- shell: /usr/bin/foo
  register: result
  ignore_errors: true
- debug: { msg: "it failed" }
  when: result is failed
```

Also: `result is changed`, `succeeded` (or `success`), `skipped`. Since 2.1, `failure`, `change` and `skip` also work.
